documents.title: Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30Th June, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On 04Th August, 2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting Scheduled On Tuesday, 04Th August, 2026

analysis.summary: ELANTAS Beck India reported a 13.27% growth in revenue for the financial year 2025, reaching ₹84,780.93 lakhs. The company improved its margins by nearly 19% compared to the previous year and successfully integrated the Von Roll resin operations. Management is currently setting up a new manufacturing facility in Gujarat to support future growth. The company continues to focus on innovation, sustainability, and operational agility to navigate market volatility. ELANTAS Beck India Limited reported a 10.09% increase in revenue from operations to ₹74,851.31 lakhs for the year ended December 31, 2024, alongside a sales volume increase of 10.74%.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees strong long-term potential in markets such as electronics, e-mobility, and the power industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the markets served by ELANTAS continue to show strong long-term potential. Our materials support sectors such as electronics, e-mobility, and the power industry, areas that are closely aligned with India’s industrial growth and infrastructure expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: New opportunities are emerging in data centers, BESS, and sustainable material technologies.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also seeing new opportunities emerging in areas such as data centres, BESS, and more sustainable material technologies.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a new manufacturing facility in Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Your Company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, and is currently in the process of obtaining the requisite governmental approvals.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is evaluating future-ready manufacturing expansion through greenfield development and automation.
capex_expansion.quote: At the same time, we are evaluating future-ready manufacturing expansion through greenfield development and greater automation in order to support the evolving needs of our customers.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for the year 2025 totaled ₹3,087.84 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure incurred during the year ended 31st December, 2025 aggregated to ₹ 3,087.84 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Margins improved by nearly 19% compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew by 13.27 percent during the year, while margins improved by nearly 19 percent as compared to the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company scaled its manufacturing capacity for CTC products within three months to meet demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing agility enabled us to respond swiftly to the surge in demand from the CTC (Continuous transposed conductor), scaling capabilities within three months to meet evolving customer requirements.

orders_capacity.claim: The company commenced manufacturing of 22 new products at its Pimpri plant.
orders_capacity.quote: Additionally, your Company is progressing towards technology absorption and localisation of the HV resin business in India and has commenced manufacturing of 22 new such products at its Pimpri plant.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a volume level of 32,491 mts during the year, representing a 10.74% increase compared to the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: Despite the series of challenging extraneous factors, pressure on the rupee, your Company achieved a volume level of 32,491 mts, a 10.74% increase as compared to previous year i.e. 29,339 mts.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share for the year 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of ₹ 7.50/- per equity share of ₹ 10/- each, subject to the deduction of tax as applicable, for the year ended 31st December, 2025 (previous year ₹ 7.50/- per equity share).

capital_allocation.claim: Funding for the land purchase in Bharuch, Gujarat was sourced from internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The funding for the said purchase has been sourced from the Company’s internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced volatility in global supply chains, raw material prices, and geopolitical tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year 2025 unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.

management_commitments.claim: ALTANA has set a target to reduce emissions by 90 percent across Scope 1, 2 and 3 by 2050.
management_commitments.quote: ALTANA has set a target to reduce emissions by 90 percent across Scope 1, 2 and 3 by 2050, a target validated by the Science Based Targets initiative.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
